privacy.title: Privacy first

how.lead: PhishGuard AI is an experimental URL-classification project built around structural features and machine learning.
how.step1Text: We validate and parse the URL, without browsing the destination.
how.step2Text: The Python backend extracts 20 numerical and structural features.
how.step3Text: The model can flag a URL, but cannot guarantee that it is safe or malicious.
how.disclaimer: Analysis uses FastAPI and an experimental machine learning model.
